title: Gröbner-Cell Parametrization of Punctual Hilbert Schemes
statement: Let $E\subset k[[x,y]]$ be a zero-dimensional monomial ideal, let $T'(E)$ be the parameter space of admissible perturbation matrices of its canonical Hilbert–Burch matrix $H$, and let $V(E)$ be the Gröbner cell of ideals with initial ideal $E$. Is the map $$\Phi_E:T'(E)\longrightarrow V(E),\qquad N\longmapsto I_t(H+N),$$ a bijection?

original_statement: Our evidence for the conjecture is twofold: • It holds for extremal cases: lex-segment ideals (and a slighlty more general class) and complete intersections. • The dimensions of the cells of the celullar decomposition of Hilbn (k[[x, y]]) resulting from the conjecture are correct for n \leq 30.
